transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around. It's been going on for months now. Some days I just... pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee, and that's it. But then other days, I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle at the store, buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy. It's just very strange.
When you eat the sweets, do you feel unable to control or stop yourself?

No, not really. I mean, it's not like I can't stop. I just... I eat them because they're there, I guess. I don't feel out of control or anything like that. I just eat a little bit and then I'm done. It's just odd because I don't even really want them in the first place.
Are you afraid of gaining weight or becoming fat?

No, I'm not afraid of gaining weight. It's not about that at all. I just... I don't really care about my weight right now. It's more about just having no interest in food, and then sometimes eating those sweets for no reason. But no, gaining weight isn't something I'm worrying about.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight since your eating changed?

I haven't actually stepped on a scale lately to check. But like I was saying earlier, my eating has just been completely turned around for months now. When you're only picking at toast and coffee some days, and then standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets you don't even really enjoy on other days... it's hard to tell what it's doing to my body. I suppose I might have lost a little bit of weight just from not eating regular meals, but it hasn't been a drastic amount that I've noticed.
Has a healthcare professional told you that you have a nutritional deficiency because of your eating pattern?
No, I haven't been told anything like that. I mean, I haven't really been to see a doctor to get blood work or anything done lately... so no, no one has mentioned a nutritional deficiency to me.
Has your eating pattern made it difficult for you to participate in meals or social activities with other people?

No, not really. I mean... I don't go out to eat or do a whole lot of social things anyway right now. But if I am around family or having a meal with someone, it doesn't really get in the way. I just sit there and maybe pick at my plate a bit. So, no, it hasn't made it difficult to be around people or anything like that.
How much distress does this eating pattern cause you?

It doesn't really bother me that much. I mean, I know it's not normal to eat this way, but it's just how things are right now. I don't really sit around worrying about it or feeling upset over it. It's just... it is what it is.
